source_capture_policy.rule: This artifact is institutional research only. Do not admit as a point-in-time feature until original filing/announcement bytes are captured, hashes and publication vintages are independently verified, and the source is mapped to a precise entity, account, asset and measurement period.

source_registry.retrieval_time_note: Exact web retrieval timestamp was not separately exposed; this is a date-vintage record.
limitations: The filing contains no literal XRP mention in the retrieved text.
Other crypto asset categories aggregate assets without identifying every asset.
Period-end balance-sheet amounts, average USDC product balances and unrecognized customer collateral are different measurement populations.
Management metrics are company-defined and should not be treated as independently measured market-wide flows.
The deck is from the same issuer as the 10-Q and is not an independent source.

source_registry.publisher: Circle Internet Group, Inc. / U.S. SEC
limitations: The filing describes the commercial formula, not the complete daily cash settlement ledger.
The agreement is a Circle-Coinbase commercial arrangement; it does not imply a Circle-Ripple partnership.

source_registry.publisher: Circle Internet Group, Inc. / U.S. SEC
limitations: Reported distribution-cost changes do not provide a full daily Coinbase USDC balance series.
The Q2 comparison must not be combined with Q3 Coinbase metrics without period alignment.
The announcement establishes product/network availability, not actual transaction volume or net issuance.
Coinbase Global Exchange collateral support is described as future availability, not live collateral acceptance at launch.
Ripple liquidity support is explicitly stated for Base; it is not a disclosed XRP purchase or XRPL bridge flow.
The 99% cold-storage and 1:1 backing statements are company representations, not an independent proof-of-reserves attestation in this source.
The statement is not a guarantee against all operational, cyber or insolvency risks.

circle_distribution_formula.on_platform_allocation_basis: USDC held on Coinbase platform after issuer retention
circle_distribution_formula.ecosystem_growth_allocation: Coinbase receives half of remaining payment base after amounts paid to approved third-party ecosystem participants
circle_distribution_formula.accounting: Circle accounts for the arrangement as an executory contract within distribution and transaction costs

circle_q2_2026_update.stated_driver: decrease in Coinbase share of total average USDC on-platform balances

interpretation: Circle and Coinbase have a direct, material distribution/economic relationship tied to USDC platform balances and reserve economics.
Coinbase's 22B average USDC product balance is a company-defined quarterly average; it is not the same as period-end USDC assets-on-platform.
Coinbase's support for RLUSD does not terminate or replace its Circle agreement.
Coinbase's RLUSD listing creates a multi-issuer distribution platform relationship, not evidence of a Circle-Ripple partnership.

recognized_lending_collateral_usd.other_asset_disclosure_rule: No individual asset within the Other crypto assets category represented more than 5% of the fair value of total crypto assets held as collateral.

coinbase_collateral_and_capital.reconciliation_rule: 997.557M recognized lending crypto collateral + 301.943M recognized derivatives collateral = 1.2995B balance-sheet crypto assets held as collateral.
coinbase_collateral_and_capital.customer_asset_policy: Coinbase states it does not use customer assets as collateral for loans, margin, rehypothecation or similar activities without customer consent.

xrp_specific_disclosure.conclusion: The filing does not establish XRP collateral acceptance or XRP collateral balances. XRP could be within an aggregated Other crypto assets or unrecognized customer-collateral category, but the filing does not identify it. Do not infer either presence or absence.

interpretation: Coinbase is a distributor and trading platform for RLUSD, not the issuer.
The issuer remains Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC.
RLUSD deposits/withdrawals on XRPL can increase XRPL stablecoin utility without proving that users acquire or hold XRP.
Global Exchange collateral support was announced as future availability; it must not be represented as live on October 28.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase's USDC distribution economics remain significant while its RLUSD listing indicates a multi-issuer stablecoin platform strategy.
counter_hypotheses.alternative: RLUSD may remain a smaller complementary asset with limited actual volume; listing alone does not demonstrate meaningful substitution for USDC.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Coinbase product-level RLUSD balances and volumes
Coinbase's future collateral eligibility and actual posted balances

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase's SEC filing does not identify XRP in its disclosed collateral tables.
counter_hypotheses.alternative: XRP could be part of the aggregated Other crypto assets or unrecognized customer collateral categories, but the filing does not provide enough detail to establish this.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: RLUSD availability on XRPL increases stablecoin utility and exchange access but may settle directly in RLUSD without XRP bridge demand.
counter_hypotheses.alternative: Cross-currency, liquidity-provider or corridor workflows may require XRP inventory or bridge legs, but no volume evidence is provided.
disconfirming_evidence_to_seek: Coinbase/Ripple corridor settlement and inventory disclosures

reasons: Corporate financial and collateral disclosures are period-end or quarterly aggregates, not high-frequency XRP market features.
Coinbase's collateral disclosures do not identify XRP asset-level balances.
Coinbase and Circle USDC economics are company-defined and must be kept separate from XRP demand.
Coinbase's RLUSD launch establishes network availability but does not disclose transaction volume, net issuance or XRP bridge usage.
No synchronized, raw-byte, independently timestamped dataset or out-of-sample predictive lift is established.
